subject: Midday snapshot inclusion for rolling-window audit coverage
messages:
From: Jenny Huang <jenny.huang@brightbank.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: audits@brightbank.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarification: midday/hourly snapshots included in SOC 2 coverage?

Sofia / Marissa,

Quick question from our control testing team as we reconcile evidence for BrightBank's SOC 2 Type II review covering 2024-06-01 through 2025-05-31. The auditor notes reference "point-in-time snapshots and rolling-window metrics" but the description is ambiguous about which artifacts were considered in-scope. Specifically:

- We see scheduled automated snapshots taken every hour, and a daily snapshot captured at 12:00 UTC. Can you confirm whether the 12:00 UTC daily snapshot (and the hourly snapshots for the same period) were included as in-scope point-in-time evidence for the period above?
- If included, can you indicate whether the timestamps on those snapshots are stored in UTC or a local timezone, and whether any snapshots were retained outside the stated coverage window (e.g., snapshots retained for longer in backups)?

If helpful, a short confirmation note (1-2 sentences) or a bridge-letter style statement that we can attach to the evidence packet would be ideal. Also, could you point us to the exported logs or manifest that shows the snapshot timestamps?

Thanks — trying to keep the paperwork tight for re-performance testing.

Best,
Jenny Huang
Senior IT Audit Manager
BrightBank Audit Team

---
Attachment requested: please attach the manifest or a sample exported log showing snapshot timestamps (CSV or similar).

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Jenny Huang <jenny.huang@brightbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarification: midday/hourly snapshots included in SOC 2 coverage?

Hi Jenny — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Karthik from Compliance (he owns the artifact exports) and Marissa who managed the audit evidence handoff.

Short answer: we believe the 12:00 UTC daily snapshot and the hourly snapshots were part of the evidence set provided to the auditor, but I want Karthik to confirm the retention window and whether any snapshots were truncated or shifted due to DST or regional daylight adjustments.

Two quick clarifying questions for your team while Karthik confirms: 
- Would the auditor accept a short cover note from Redwood stating that "automated hourly snapshots and the daily 12:00 UTC snapshot within the stated period were produced from our snapshot service and retained according to our retention policy"?
- Do you need the raw CSV manifest with per-snapshot timestamps, or is a summarized manifest (daily list + retention flags) sufficient for your re-performance?

I can assemble a one-paragraph bridge note once Karthik confirms the technical details.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0142

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jenny Huang <jenny.huang@brightbank.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarification: midday/hourly snapshots included in SOC 2 coverage?

Hi all,

I pulled the exports and checked the retention manifest. Summary: 
- The SOC 2 Type II evidence package we delivered to BrightBank's auditor included the scheduled automated hourly snapshots taken by our snapshot service and the daily snapshot captured at 12:00 UTC. These were produced from the production snapshot pipeline and match the timestamps in the manifest.
- All snapshot timestamps are recorded in UTC in the system metadata. There was no daylight-savings translation applied to stored timestamps — ingest and storage are UTC-native.
- Retention: snapshots within the audit window (2024-06-01 through 2025-05-31) are present in the exports. A subset of older snapshots exists in cold backups, but those are beyond the stated period and were not included in the package we provided.

I've attached a short CSV extract (exported-logs-2025-06-30.csv) that shows a sample of hourly snapshot timestamps and the daily 12:00 UTC entries. I also uploaded the full manifest and the formal SOC 2 report to the evidence folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/BRIGHTBANK-AUDIT-2027

If BrightBank's audit team needs a formal bridge letter, we can provide a one-paragraph confirmation stating: 

"Redwood Inference confirms that automated hourly snapshots and the daily 12:00 UTC snapshot for the period 2024-06-01 through 2025-05-31 were generated by the production snapshot service, stored with UTC timestamps, and included in the artifact set provided to the auditor. Snapshots outside that period were retained in cold backup but were not part of the evidence package for the SOC 2 Type II examination."

Sofia / Marissa: happy to have Marissa sign/approve the final wording. Jenny: let us know if you need any additional fields in the CSV (e.g., object hashes or storage location identifiers) — we can produce them by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: exported-logs-2025-06-30.csv

From: Jenny Huang <jenny.huang@brightbank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, audits@brightbank.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarification: midday/hourly snapshots included in SOC 2 coverage?

Karthik / Sofia — this is perfect, thank you. The CSV extract looks good and the UTC confirmation answers the auditor's timezone question.

A one-paragraph bridge letter like the draft you suggested would be sufficient for our file. Can you please send the finalized one-paragraph statement on Redwood letterhead (or as a signed PDF) before close of business Friday, 2027-06-18? Once we have that we can attach it to the evidence packet and finish control re-performance on our side.

One minor follow-up: can you include the manifest path or object IDs in the cover note so our testing team can reference the exact objects used in re-performance? Otherwise we might have to map by timestamp alone.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best regards,
Jenny Huang
Senior IT Audit Manager
BrightBank Audit Team
